category_title: Reintegrated learners with BESD exhibiting social-emotional dysregulation and authority defiance
minimal_context: The student is in a mainstream classroom attempting to catch up on lost worksheet assignments while peers are present.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please sit at your desk and start catching up on the worksheet you missed yesterday.

STUDENT: I don't even know what to do. I was feeling angry all the time and I can't concentrate on this.

TUTOR: Just try your best to focus on the paper and get it done.

STUDENT: (Turns around to the desk behind) Stop looking at my paper! The only reason I am bad is because people wind me up and I cannot control my behaviour.

TUTOR: Please ignore them and get back to your own work.

STUDENT: (Throws the worksheet off the desk and starts talking loudly to the peers) No! I would rather disrupt than do this. You're all winding me up!

options.A: Positions away from the student and provides intermittent support.
options.B: Conducts an inventory of the student's triggers and responses.
options.C: Sends a clear message to the student regarding dissatisfaction with their behavior.
options.D: Asks the student if they are having difficulties with the worksheet.
